name: Request hosted deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions: {}

jobs:
  request:
    name: Request deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      DEPLOY_REPOSITORY: ${{ vars.HOSTED_DEPLOY_REPOSITORY }}
      DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOSTED_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
      DEPLOY_WORKFLOW: ${{ vars.HOSTED_DEPLOY_WORKFLOW }}
      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Check deployment token
        id: configuration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${DEPLOY_TOKEN}" ]] || \
            [[ -z "${DEPLOY_REPOSITORY}" ]] || \
            [[ -z "${DEPLOY_WORKFLOW}" ]]; then
            echo "Hosted deployment is not configured yet."
            echo "enabled=false" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          else
            if [[ ! "${DEPLOY_REPOSITORY}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]] || \
              [[ ! "${DEPLOY_WORKFLOW}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]]; then
              echo "Hosted deployment configuration is invalid."
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "enabled=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi

      - name: Dispatch hosted deployment
        if: steps.configuration.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          payload="$(jq -cn \
            --arg ref main \
            --arg source_sha "${SOURCE_SHA}" \
            '{ref:$ref,inputs:{source_sha:$source_sha}}')"
          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
            --request POST \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer ${DEPLOY_TOKEN}" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            --data "${payload}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${DEPLOY_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/${DEPLOY_WORKFLOW}/dispatches"

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@0ebf47130e4866e96fce0953f49152a61190b271 # v6.0.9

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm lint

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build
